title: Illusion Momentum Cross-Sectional Signal on H198 30-Stock Large-Cap Universe
description: Test the 'Illusion Momentum' signal from Iwanaga (2024 working paper / published as Iwanaga & Hirose, Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Vol 96, 2026). FORMULA — the signal is MOM minus SUM, NOT SUM minus MOM: IMOM = [Π(1+r_t) − 1] − Σ(r_t), i.e., compound return minus arithmetic sum. For a stock up 10% then down 10%: MOM = −1%, SUM = 0%, IMOM = −1% (low). For a stock with consistent sequential gains (e.g., +5%, +5%): MOM = 10.25%, SUM = 10%, IMOM = +0.25% (positive). High IMOM identifies stocks whose compounding worked in their favor (sustained directional moves), NOT volatile round-trip stocks. The cognitive bias mechanism: investors see the arithmetic sum and underestimate the true compound return — underreaction to genuine sustained momentum creates a predictable drift. Primary spec: 6-month formation window, NO skip-month (same convention as H377 6-0m). High-Low alpha in original paper: 1.39% raw / 1.42% risk-adjusted (6M). Both 6M and 12M are significant; 6M is larger. Formation confirmed no-skip in paper footnote 7. Decay by decade: 2.62% (1990s), 1.42% (2000s), 0.55% (2010s+) — effect persists but is smaller in recent data; temper Sharpe expectations for 2021-2026 OOS window. MECHANISM distinct from MAX/HTP limited-attention: paper explicitly rejects underreaction-to-attention explanation; effect is stronger with |IMOM| magnitude. Do not assume shared behavioral story with H373 MAX references. Implementation: (1) Compute monthly IMOM = [Π(1+r_t for t in last 6 months) − 1] − Σ(r_t for t in last 6 months) for each H198 stock; (2) test as standalone ranking (top-1, top-2, top-3); (3) test as composite blend with H377 6-0m; (4) SPY 200MA overlay variant. Gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.174 AND MaxDD > −30%. IS: 2013-2020, OOS: 2021-2026. Script: backtesting/daily/run_h385.py. PROVENANCE NOTE: Full spec sourced from Iwanaga (2024) working paper (Tamagawa University/Yu-cho Foundation grant), which is almost certainly the pre-publication draft of PBFJ 2026. Published version not independently verified — cite working paper for these formula specifics.
rationale: H198 30-stock large-cap universe matches the paper's US large-cap confirmation exactly. Zero cost — same monthly OHLCV data already used for H198/H377. IMOM is mechanically orthogonal to H377: H377 ranks on geometric compound return (MOM); H385 ranks on how much MOM exceeds SUM. They can co-vary (both are positive for steadily rising stocks) but measure distinct properties — IMOM captures 'how consistent were the gains' while H377 captures 'how large was the total return'. A blend of IMOM rank + H377 rank could improve selection within the top-momentum bucket. The recent alpha decay (1.42% in 2000s → 0.55% in 2010s) is a realistic expectation-setter: if OOS 2021-2026 Sharpe lands in the 1.0-1.5 range rather than a H377-level 3.0+, that's consistent with the literature trend, not a failure.
source_paper: Iwanaga (2024) working paper / Iwanaga & Hirose (2026), Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Vol 96, DOI: 10.1016/j.pacfin.2026.103063
